parent_signal: Exact ASHARE-DEEP-DECLINE-INTRADAY-UNDERCUT-FULL-ABSORPTION-V1 mother signal; no signal condition, cooldown, entry rule, universe rule, or candidate identity changes.
economic_hypothesis: The same supply-absorption candle has different natural monetization clocks in different causal market states. Positive medium-horizon markets can support slower continuation; systemic selloffs can support a sharp but bounded snapback; ordinary weak markets often offer only a short reflex bounce before the unresolved decline resumes.
chart_basis: All 1,583 signal charts from 2014-2020 were reviewed before this contract. The review found that stock-only candle morphology overlapped strongly, while path duration differed economically by contemporaneous market structure. This is development, not independent confirmation.

market_state.decision_clock: Completed signal-session close. Every component uses the signal close or earlier completed sessions only and is frozen before the first possible fill.
market_state.cross_section: All same-date symbols satisfying hard_valid, history_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, not corporate_action_blocking, and not is_st.
market_state.UP: Cross-sectional median registered ret60 is strictly greater than 0.
market_state.DOWN_SYSTEMIC: Median ret60 is non-positive and either (a) the cross-sectional median five-session coordinate return ending immediately before the signal is <= -5%, or (b) at least 90% of the eligible signal-date cross-section has registered step_return > 0.
market_state.DOWN_ORDINARY: Median ret60 is non-positive and DOWN_SYSTEMIC is false.
market_state.missing_policy: Fail closed: no entry if any required market-state aggregate is unavailable.

UP.rationale: Allow medium-horizon continuation in a positive broad trend.

DOWN_SYSTEMIC.rationale: Monetize the broad forced-sale snapback without assuming a new bull trend.

DOWN_ORDINARY.rationale: Treat the candle as a short reflex bounce because common selling pressure has not reached or exited a systemic state.

execution.entry: First legal executable daily open strictly after the signal, no later than the third subsequent market-session index.
execution.target_eligibility: From the first T+1 sellable session after entry.
execution.time_stop: After the frozen number of completed market-session indices, exit at the next legal sellable open.

prohibited: No future market return, future high/low, later breadth, year label, or full-sample percentile in state construction.
No alternative target or horizon after this replay.
No 2021 signal outcome read unless 2014-2020 passes the frozen gate.
No challenge read unless 2014-2021 passes the frozen gate.
